#Score Variables
```{r Recoded variables}
#Age
ChatBots_DATA$age <- 2026 - ChatBots_DATA$birthyr

#PHQ
ChatBots_DATA$PHQ9_total <- rowSums(
  ChatBots_DATA[, c(
    "Depression_1",
    "Depression_2",
    "Depression_3",
    "Depression_4",
    "Depression_5",
    "Depression_6",
    "Depression_7",
    "Depression_8",
    "Depression_9"
  )],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

ChatBots_DATA$PHQ9_cutoff <- ifelse(
ChatBots_DATA$PHQ9_total >= 10, 1, 0)

#GAD
ChatBots_DATA$GAD7_total <- rowSums(
  ChatBots_DATA[, c(
    "Anxiety_1",
    "Anxiety_2",
    "Anxiety_3",
    "Anxiety_4",
    "Anxiety_5",
    "Anxiety_6",
    "Anxiety_7"
  )],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

ChatBots_DATA$GAD7_cutoff <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$GAD7_total >= 8,1, 0
)

#Help-Seeking
ChatBots_DATA$Professional_help_yes <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Professional_help == 1,1,0)

ChatBots_DATA$Friend_yes <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Friend == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$Family_yes <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Family == 1, 1, 0)

# General AI Chatbot Use
ChatBots_DATA$Ai_ever_use_yes <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_ever_use == 1,1,0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_30day_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_frequency %in% c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6),1,0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_daily_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_frequency %in% c(5, 6),1,0)

# AI Platforms
ChatBots_DATA$ChatGPT <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_1 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$Gemini <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_2 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$Claude <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_3 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$Copilot <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_4 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$MetaAI <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_6 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$Grok <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_7 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$OtherAI <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_14 == 1, 1, 0)

# Lifetime AI Mental Health Support Use
ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support == 1, 1, 0
)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use[is.na(ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use)] <- 0

# Past 30-Day AI Mental Health Support Use
ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_30day_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_frequency %in% c(2,3,4,5,6),1,0)

# Daily AI Mental Health Support Use
ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_daily_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_frequency %in% c(5,6),1,0)

# Lifetime AI Substance-Use Support
ChatBots_DATA$AI_substance_lifetime_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_subst == 1, 1, 0
)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_substance_lifetime_use[is.na(ChatBots_DATA$AI_substance_lifetime_use)] <- 0

#Support Type
ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_advice <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_1 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_feelings <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_2 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_emotions_out <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_3 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_situation <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_4 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_plan <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_5 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_emotional_support <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_6 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_positive <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_7 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_sympathy <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_8 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

# Make not asked / skipped missing for this section because this is among AI MH support users
reason_vars <- c(
  "AI_reason_advice",
  "AI_reason_feelings",
  "AI_reason_emotions_out",
  "AI_reason_situation",
  "AI_reason_plan",
  "AI_reason_emotional_support",
  "AI_reason_positive",
  "AI_reason_sympathy")

ChatBots_DATA[ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use != 1, reason_vars] <- NA

# AI Support Functions
ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_available <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_1 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_less_judged <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_2 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_easier <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_3 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_comfortable <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_4 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_less_lonely <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_5 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_guidance <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_6 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_cheaper <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_7 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_other <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_8 == 1, 1, 0)

#Daily Social Media use
ChatBots_DATA$Daily_SM_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_1 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_2 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_3 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_4 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_5 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_6 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_7 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_8 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_9 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_10 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_11 %in% c(4,5),
  1, 0
)

# AUDIT-C scoring
ChatBots_DATA <- ChatBots_DATA %>%
  mutate(
    AUDIT_C_1_score = as.numeric(AUDIT_C_1),

    AUDIT_C_2_score = case_when(
      AUDIT_C_1 == 0 ~ 0,
      AUDIT_C_2 == 9 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(AUDIT_C_2)
    ),

    AUDIT_C_3_score = case_when(
      AUDIT_C_1 == 0 ~ 0,
      AUDIT_C_3 == 9 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(AUDIT_C_3)
    ),

    AUDIT_C_total =
      AUDIT_C_1_score +
      AUDIT_C_2_score +
      AUDIT_C_3_score
  )

#AI Chatbot Use for Alcohol/Drug Concerns
ChatBots_DATA <- ChatBots_DATA %>%
  mutate(
    AI_support_subst_recode = case_when(
      Ai_support_subst == 1 ~ 1,
      Ai_support_subst == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

#Hazardous Drinking (AUDIT-C)
ChatBots_DATA <- ChatBots_DATA %>%
  mutate(
    AUDIT_C_hazardous = case_when(

      # Men: AUDIT-C >= 4
      gender4 == 1 & AUDIT_C_total >= 4 ~ 1,

      # Women, non-binary, and other: AUDIT-C >= 3
      gender4 %in% c(2, 3, 4) & AUDIT_C_total >= 3 ~ 1,

      # Below the applicable cutoff
      gender4 == 1 & AUDIT_C_total < 4 ~ 0,
      gender4 %in% c(2, 3, 4) & AUDIT_C_total < 3 ~ 0,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )


```
```{r Survey weighted object}
design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~weight,
  data = ChatBots_DATA
)

#Helper function
# Weighted %
w_pct <- function(var){
  svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), design, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Weighted mean
w_mean <- function(var){
  svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), design, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Weighted SD
w_sd <- function(var){
  sqrt(svyvar(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), design, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```
```{r Survey duration}
ChatBots_DATA$starttime <- as.POSIXct(ChatBots_DATA$starttime)
ChatBots_DATA$endtime   <- as.POSIXct(ChatBots_DATA$endtime)

ChatBots_DATA$duration_min <-
  as.numeric(difftime(ChatBots_DATA$endtime,
                      ChatBots_DATA$starttime,
                      units="mins"))

summary(ChatBots_DATA$duration_min)

median(ChatBots_DATA$duration_min)

quantile(ChatBots_DATA$duration_min,
         probs=c(.01,.05,.10,.90,.95,.99))

sum(ChatBots_DATA$duration_min > 60, na.rm = TRUE)

sum(ChatBots_DATA$duration_min > 120, na.rm = TRUE)

sum(ChatBots_DATA$duration_min > 1440, na.rm = TRUE)  # >1 day
```

#Table 4
```{r Lifetime mental health use}
#PHQ-9 cutoff
MH_PHQ9_lifetime <- svyglm(
  PHQ9_cutoff ~ AI_MH_lifetime_use +
    age +
    factor(gender4) +
    factor(race) +
    educ +
    Daily_SM_use,
  design = design,
  family = quasibinomial()
)

summary(MH_PHQ9_lifetime)

# Odds Ratio
exp(coef(MH_PHQ9_lifetime))

# 95% CI
exp(confint(MH_PHQ9_lifetime))

# GAD-7 cutoff
MH_GAD7_lifetime <- svyglm(
  GAD7_cutoff ~ AI_MH_lifetime_use +
    age +
    factor(gender4) +
    factor(race) +
    educ +
    Daily_SM_use,
  design = design,
  family = quasibinomial()
)

summary(MH_GAD7_lifetime)

# Odds Ratio
exp(coef(MH_GAD7_lifetime))

# 95% CI
exp(confint(MH_GAD7_lifetime))

# PHQ-9 total score
MH_PHQ9_total_lifetime <- svyglm(
  PHQ9_total ~ AI_MH_lifetime_use +
    age +
    factor(gender4) +
    factor(race) +
    educ +
    Daily_SM_use,
  design = design
)

summary(MH_PHQ9_total_lifetime)

# Beta
coef(MH_PHQ9_total_lifetime)

# 95% CI
confint(MH_PHQ9_total_lifetime)

# GAD-7 total score
```

#BH Correction
```{r Multiple-comparison corrections}
# Helper function 
extract_svy_p <- function(model, term, exposure, outcome, table) {
  
  coef_table <- summary(model)$coefficients
  
  # Automatically identify the p-value column
  p_col <- grep("^Pr\\(", colnames(coef_table), value = TRUE)
  
  if (length(p_col) != 1) {
    stop("Could not uniquely identify the p-value column.")
  }
  
  if (!term %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
    stop(paste("Term", term, "was not found in the model."))
  }
  
  data.frame(
    table = table,
    exposure = exposure,
    outcome = outcome,
    term = term,
    estimate = coef_table[term, "Estimate"],
    p_value = coef_table[term, p_col],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# OPTION 1: Adjust separately within each conceptual family
table4_pvalues$p_BH_within_table <-
  p.adjust(table4_pvalues$p_value, method = "BH")

table4_pvalues$p_Bonferroni_within_table <-
  p.adjust(table4_pvalues$p_value, method = "bonferroni")

table5_pvalues$p_BH_within_table <-
  p.adjust(table5_pvalues$p_value, method = "BH")

table5_pvalues$p_Bonferroni_within_table <-
  p.adjust(table5_pvalues$p_value, method = "bonferroni")


# Adjust across all 21 inferential tests
all_pvalues <- rbind(table4_pvalues, table5_pvalues)

all_pvalues$p_BH_all_tests <-
  p.adjust(all_pvalues$p_value, method = "BH")

all_pvalues$p_Bonferroni_all_tests <-
  p.adjust(all_pvalues$p_value, method = "bonferroni")


# Indicators of statistical significance
all_pvalues$significant_unadjusted <-
  all_pvalues$p_value < .05

all_pvalues$significant_BH_all_tests <-
  all_pvalues$p_BH_all_tests < .05

all_pvalues$significant_Bonferroni_all_tests <-
  all_pvalues$p_Bonferroni_all_tests < .05


# Round values for easier review
all_pvalues$p_value_rounded <-
  round(all_pvalues$p_value, 4)

all_pvalues$p_BH_all_tests_rounded <-
  round(all_pvalues$p_BH_all_tests, 4)

all_pvalues$p_Bonferroni_all_tests_rounded <-
  round(all_pvalues$p_Bonferroni_all_tests, 4)


# Display complete results
all_pvalues[
  ,
  c(
    "table",
    "exposure",
    "outcome",
    "estimate",
    "p_value_rounded",
    "p_BH_all_tests_rounded",
    "p_Bonferroni_all_tests_rounded",
    "significant_unadjusted",
    "significant_BH_all_tests",
    "significant_Bonferroni_all_tests"
  )
]


# Show only results whose significance changes after BH correction
subset(
  all_pvalues,
  significant_unadjusted != significant_BH_all_tests,
  select = c(
    table,
    exposure,
    outcome,
    p_value,
    p_BH_all_tests,
    significant_unadjusted,
    significant_BH_all_tests
  )
)
```

```{r Table 2}
# Create new demographic variables without overwriting raw variables
ChatBots_DATA <- ChatBots_DATA %>%
  mutate(
    gender3 = case_when(
      gender4 == 1 ~ "Man",
      gender4 == 2 ~ "Woman",
      gender4 %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Gender diverse",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    gender3 = factor(
      gender3,
      levels = c("Man", "Woman", "Gender diverse")
    ),
    race_factor = factor(
      race,
      levels = 1:8,
      labels = c(
        "White",
        "Black",
        "Hispanic",
        "Asian",
        "Native American",
        "Two or more races",
        "Other",
        "Middle Eastern"
      )
    ),

    race_factor = relevel(race_factor, ref = "White")
  )

# Verify recodes
table(ChatBots_DATA$gender3, useNA = "ifany")
table(ChatBots_DATA$race_factor, useNA = "ifany")

# Rebuild survey design
design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~weight,
  data = ChatBots_DATA
)

# Survey-weighted logistic regression
table2_model <- svyglm(
  AI_support_subst_recode ~
    age +
    gender3 +
    race_factor,
  design = design,
  family = quasibinomial()
)

summary(table2_model)

# Adjusted odds ratios, confidence intervals, and p values
table2_results <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(coef(table2_model)),
  aOR = exp(coef(table2_model)),
  Lower95 = exp(confint(table2_model)[, 1]),
  Upper95 = exp(confint(table2_model)[, 2]),
  p = summary(table2_model)$coefficients[, 4]
) %>%
  mutate(
    `aOR (95% CI)` = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      aOR,
      Lower95,
      Upper95
    ),
    `p value` = ifelse(
      p < .001,
      "<.001",
      sprintf("%.3f", p)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Variable,
    `aOR (95% CI)`,
    `p value`
  )

table2_results
```
